# All tools

GigAI Tools has 273 live tools in 11 categories. Each category page lists every tool with what it does, the files it takes and makes, and where it runs. Each tool name opens the tool on gigai.tools.

| Category | Tools | What they work on |
|---|---|---|
| [File Intelligence](file-intelligence.md) | 3 | Flagship GigAI experiences that work out what your file is and what to do with it: starting with hitting an exact size. |
| [Image Studio](image-tools.md) | 10 | Get every image ready for the web, social and upload forms: compress, convert, resize, crop and edit right in your browser, nothing uploaded. |
| [PDF Studio](pdf-tools.md) | 38 | Every tool you need to work with PDFs, in one place, merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign and protect, all privately in your browser. |
| [Document Studio](document-tools.md) | 9 | Reshape and read the data formats work actually arrives in (CSV, Excel, JSON, EPUB and RTF) with a real desktop-app feel, entirely in your browser. |
| [Developer Studio](developer-tools.md) | 32 | Ship cleaner code faster: format, validate, encode, decode and generate with the utilities of everyday development work. |
| [QR Studio](qr-tools.md) | 36 | Put anything a scan away, design, brand, batch and decode QR codes in a full studio that runs entirely in your browser. |
| [SEO Studio](seo-tools.md) | 51 | Win the click before the page even loads: craft meta tags, structured data, sitemaps and robots rules, and preview exactly how you appear on Google and social. |
| [SVG Studio](svg-tools.md) | 30 | Make vectors production-ready, optimize, convert, generate and inspect SVG: shrink files, produce React components or data URIs, trace raster art, craft blobs and waves. |
| [GEO Studio](geo-tools.md) | 11 | The free technical layer under AI visibility: check whether AI crawlers can reach your site, whether they can read it without JavaScript, and whether there's anything on it a model could actually cite. |
| [Video Studio](video-tools.md) | 28 | Make every clip fit its destination, trim, convert, compress and extract audio from video, quick and hassle-free in your browser. |
| [Audio Studio](audio-tools.md) | 25 | Shape sound without installing a DAW: trim, convert, record, merge and master audio in your browser, powered by the native Web Audio engine. |

**Runs** means where your data is processed:

- *Browser*: on your device only. Nothing is uploaded.
- *Browser, URL via proxy*: pasted content stays on your device; a URL you enter is fetched by the site's proxy.
- *Browser and backend*: one part of the tool uses the backend, as the category page explains.
